Aaron Cowen increased its stake in United Technologies Corp (UTX) by 32.46% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Suvretta Capital Management Llc bought 650,240 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.23% with the market. The hedge fund run by Aaron Cowen held 2.65 million shares of the aerospace company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $333.85 million, up from 2.00M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Suvretta Capital Management Llc who had been investing in United Technologies Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $102.10B market cap company. The stock increased 0.02% or $0.03 $127.61. About 2.76M shares traded. United Technologies Corporation (NYSE:UTX) has risen 3.91% since June 11, 2017 and is uptrending.
